body:
HUMAN DECISION D21 (2026-10-03 ~17:40 local): add a behaviour-preserving refactor slice to mission 02. The assignment's brownfield scope names refactors, and none is in the run yet. Please schedule it now, the same way as 04-audit-columns and 05-ci-cd: slice.yaml, wave map, rig workflow revise, and the mission plan-lock re-stamped on the human's behalf.

Slice: 06-client-identity (suggested id), low tier, delegated plan-lock. Lane B is idle right now (design2, dev2, qa2, review2), so lane B is suggested.

Outcome: one component answers "who is this client" (architecture.md §11, register row 1). Behaviour is unchanged.
- New web/ClientIdentity owns three things: the trusted-proxy rule (today RateLimitFilter.clientOf), the request attribute carrying the resolved client (today RateLimitFilter.CLIENT_ATTRIBUTE), and the audit guard's "direct loopback caller, no forwarding header, no remote-IP rewriting configured" predicate (today in AuditController).
- RateLimitFilter, ClickRecorder and AuditController call it instead of deriving the client themselves.
- ADR-0015 is amended to name ClientIdentity as the one code path, and the register row is updated by its owner, design-agent.

Proof obligations (brownfield.md §6, refactors):
- Characterization tests come first and pin today's exact answers across the matrix: peer, X-Forwarded-For and Forwarded headers, trusted-proxy lists, loopback or not, and both Tomcat remoteip settings (the CR-01 cases).
- The move lands in its own commits, separate from test changes.
- Every existing journey passes unchanged, notably AuditForwardedHeadersJourneyTest, the rate-limit journeys and analytics-v2's unique-visitor journeys.
- Coverage stays at 100 %. The API document, schema, responses and log lines are unchanged: QA diffs the regenerated document and compares live responses before and after.
- No new behaviour, setting, endpoint or dependency.

Mission effects:
- Mission 02's wave review, now running, continues on the five merged slices and later adds this slice's range only.
- Mission 02's release prep and ship sign-off wait for this slice.
- Mission 03 is unaffected and proceeds to release on its own; the operator will route its release_prep to release2-agent if both missions are in release work at once.
- Expected cost: about 1.5 hours on mission 02. The new estimate for mission 02's sign-off is about 8:45 to 9:00 pm local.

Close with no-follow-on naming the slice id and its instance.
summary: HUMAN DECISION D21: add a behaviour-preserving refactor slice to mission 02 — one web/ClientIdentity for client identity (register row 1); characterization tests first; start now on idle lane B
